methods.title: Doublet detection (scDblFinder)
methods.summary: Scores each cell with scDblFinder and records scDblFinder.class and scDblFinder.score. Cells are annotated, not removed; remove doublets with Subset cells.

provenance.title: scDblFinder vignette (Usage)
provenance.citation: Germain P-L et al. Doublet identification in single-cell sequencing data using scDblFinder. F1000Research 2021.

deviations: Seurat v5 count layers are joined on a copy before scoring so every cell is scored once.
Doublets are only annotated; removal is a separate Subset cells step.

parameters.label: Sample column (blank for one sample)
parameters.help: Doublets form within a capture; give the column naming each 10x capture/sample.

methods.title: Subset cells by metadata
methods.summary: Keeps or removes cells whose value in one metadata column is in a list, for example removing doublets, dropping a low-quality cluster, or selecting one lineage before re-clustering.

provenance.title: Seurat Guided Clustering Tutorial (subset)
provenance.citation: Hao Y et al. Dictionary learning for integrative, multimodal and scalable single-cell analysis. Nat Biotechnol 2024.

deviations: Selection is by listed values of one column instead of a free-form subset expression.

parameters.label: Keep or remove the listed values
Stop if fewer cells would remain

methods.title: Re-cluster with optional batch integration (Seurat v5)
methods.summary: Normalizes, finds variable features, runs PCA, optionally integrates batches (CCA, RPCA or Harmony via IntegrateLayers), then clusters and computes a UMAP.

provenance.title: Integrative analysis in Seurat v5
provenance.citation: Hao Y et al. Nat Biotechnol 2024; Korsunsky I et al. Fast, sensitive and accurate integration of single-cell data with Harmony. Nat Methods 2019.

deviations: Log-normalization only; the vignette's SCTransform variant is not included.
The first count assay among RNA, Spatial and Xenium is used.
Harmony is optional and fails clearly if the harmony package is absent.

methods.title: Name clusters (manual annotation)
methods.summary: Writes cell-type names from a cluster=label mapping you provide into a metadata column and the active identities.

provenance.title: Seurat Guided Clustering Tutorial (assigning cell type identity)
provenance.citation: Hao Y et al. Nat Biotechnol 2024.

deviations: Labels are also stored in a named metadata column; unmapped clusters become Unassigned or keep their cluster id.

methods.title: Cell-cycle scoring and regression (Seurat)
methods.summary: Scores S and G2M phase with Seurat's cc.genes.updated.2019 lists (CellCycleScoring) and optionally regresses the scores out before re-clustering.

provenance.title: Cell-Cycle Scoring and Regression
provenance.citation: Tirosh I et al. Dissecting the multicellular ecosystem of metastatic melanoma by single-cell RNA-seq. Science 2016; Hao Y et al. Nat Biotechnol 2024.

deviations: Regression scales variable features (all genes when none are set) rather than every gene, to bound memory.
Mouse gene lists are the human lists converted to title case.
After regression the method re-runs PCA, neighbors, clustering and UMAP so the result is ready to use.

parameters.label: Regress cell cycle
parameters.help: difference keeps the separation between cycling and non-cycling cells, as in the vignette's alternative workflow.

methods.title: Gene signature scores (AddModuleScore)
methods.summary: Scores each cell for one or more gene signatures with Seurat's AddModuleScore (Tirosh et al. 2016) and summarizes mean scores per group.

provenance.title: Seurat AddModuleScore reference
provenance.citation: Tirosh I et al. Science 2016; Hao Y et al. Nat Biotechnol 2024.

deviations: Score columns are renamed from Name_score1 to Name_score.
Genes absent from the data are dropped and reported in the coverage table.

metrics.label: fewest genes found in a set

methods.title: Expression figures (dot, violin, feature, UMAP)
methods.summary: Draws the standard Seurat expression figures for a gene list: DotPlot with its data table, VlnPlot, FeaturePlot and a labeled UMAP. Display only.

provenance.title: Seurat data visualization methods
provenance.citation: Hao Y et al. Nat Biotechnol 2024.

deviations: Panels are limited to the first max-panels genes; the dot plot shows every listed gene that is present.

methods.title: Differential cell-type abundance (propeller)
methods.summary: Tests whether cell-type or cluster proportions differ between conditions with speckle's propeller, using biological samples as replicates.

provenance.title: speckle vignette (propeller)
provenance.citation: Phipson B et al. propeller: testing for differences in cell type proportions in single cell data. Bioinformatics 2022.

deviations: The method refuses samples assigned to more than one condition and conditions with fewer replicates than the minimum you set.
The proportions figure is drawn with ggplot2 instead of plotCellTypeProps so each sample is visible.

parameters.label: FDR threshold for the summary count

methods.title: Trajectory and pseudotime (slingshot)
methods.summary: Fits lineages through clusters on a PCA or integrated embedding with slingshot and stores per-lineage pseudotime and curve weights.

provenance.title: Slingshot: Trajectory Inference for Single-Cell Data
provenance.citation: Street K et al. Slingshot: cell lineage and pseudotime inference for single-cell transcriptomics. BMC Genomics 2018.

deviations: slingshot is run on the embedding matrix and cluster labels rather than a SingleCellExperiment; the algorithm and arguments are the same.
A weighted mean pseudotime across lineages is added for display.

parameters.label: Start cluster (blank = inferred)
parameters.help: The root of the trajectory is a biological claim; name it when known.

methods.title: Spatially variable genes (Moran's I)
methods.summary: Ranks variable genes by spatial autocorrelation (Moran's I) with Seurat's FindSpatiallyVariableFeatures and plots the top genes on the tissue.

provenance.title: Seurat spatial vignette (spatially variable features)
provenance.citation: Hao Y et al. Nat Biotechnol 2024.

deviations: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR is added to the reported Moran's I p-values.
The first image or field of view is used.

methods.title: Cellular niches (Seurat BuildNicheAssay)
methods.summary: Groups cells into niches by k-means on the cell-type composition of their spatial neighbors, as in Seurat's image-based (Xenium) vignette.

provenance.title: Analysis of Image-based Spatial Data in Seurat (niche analysis)
provenance.citation: Hao Y et al. Nat Biotechnol 2024.

deviations: Niche labels are stored as character values; the vignette leaves them as factors.

methods.title: Ambient RNA correction (decontX)
methods.summary: Estimates per-cell ambient RNA contamination with celda's decontX and stores decontaminated counts as a new assay or in place of the original counts.

provenance.title: Decontamination of ambient RNA with DecontX
provenance.citation: Yang S et al. Decontamination of ambient RNA in single-cell RNA-seq with DecontX. Genome Biol 2020.

deviations: No empty-droplet background is available after upload, so the ambient profile is estimated from the cells (the vignette's default).
With replace-counts, original counts are kept in an <assay>_original assay.

methods.title: Pseudobulk differential expression per cell type (edgeR)
methods.summary: Sums counts per sample within each cell type and tests a test condition against a reference with edgeR quasi-likelihood, optionally paired by donor.

provenance.title: OSCA Multi-sample comparisons: DE between conditions
provenance.upstream: OSCA.multisample multi-sample-comparisons.Rmd (scran::pseudoBulkDGE) and the edgeR User's Guide
provenance.citation: Amezquita RA et al. Orchestrating single-cell analysis with Bioconductor. Nat Methods 2020; Chen Y et al. edgeR 4.0. Nucleic Acids Res 2025.

deviations: Counts are summed with a sparse indicator matrix instead of scuttle::aggregateAcrossCells; the edgeR steps match pseudoBulkDGE.
Only two conditions are compared per run; run again for other contrasts.
The table output keeps the top rows per cell type; the full result is in the full-results RDS.

parameters.label: Donor column for a paired design (optional)
Top genes per cell type in the table

methods.title: Reference cell-type annotation (SingleR)
methods.summary: Labels cells or clusters by correlation to a celldex reference (Human Primary Cell Atlas, Blueprint/ENCODE, Monaco, DICE, mouse RNA-seq, ImmGen) with SingleR.

provenance.title: Assigning cell types with SingleR
provenance.citation: Aran D et al. Reference-based analysis of lung single-cell sequencing reveals a transitional profibrotic macrophage. Nat Immunol 2019.

deviations: celldex references are read from copies saved in the R image at build time because the sandbox has no network.
Pruned (low-confidence) labels are stored as Unassigned.

methods.title: Spatial domains (BANKSY)
methods.summary: Clusters spots or cells using their own expression and their spatial neighborhood with BANKSY (SeuratWrappers::RunBanksy), giving tissue domains or spatially informed cell types.

provenance.title: Running BANKSY with Seurat
provenance.citation: Singhal V et al. BANKSY unifies cell typing and tissue domain segmentation for scalable spatial omics data analysis. Nat Genet 2024.

deviations: BANKSY clusters are written to banksy_cluster; seurat_clusters is left unchanged.
The first image or field of view is used for plotting.

parameters.label: Spatial weight (lambda)
parameters.help: 0.2 for cell typing, 0.8 for tissue domains.
